prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Begin Your Desktop Companion Journey", "body": "Choose whether to pick a classic pre-made pet or generate your own unique companion."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet AI Generation Progress Visualizer: Introduce a dedicated preview screen right after custom photo upload to show visual progress during photo processing.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_preview_studio", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_preview_studio": {"headline": "Generating Your Unique Desktop Pet", "body": "We are turning your photo into a animated desktop mascot.", "layout": "centered", "show_progress": true}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Meet Your Pet on Your Desktop!", "body": "Complete these 3 quick actions to master your pet controls.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "1. Click pet to show control menu\n2. Drag pet around desktop\n3. Press shortcut to hide/unhide", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In Before Certificate Finalization: Place sign-in immediately after pick_friend/upload_photos and before adoption_certificate so accounts are created before generating official pet records.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Restore Security Hint: Display a explicit hint under sign-in options confirming that returning users will automatically keep all previously adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in with an existing account restores all your previous pets automatically."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Pre-made vs Custom Path Outcome Clarity Body: Clarify the choose_path body text to explain instant pre-made pet activation versus custom photo pet creation time.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Adoption Method", "body": "Pick an instant companion from our standard shelter or create a bespoke AI pet from your photos."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Mascot Arrival Status Message: Update waiting screen status body with clear assurances about background rendering and display preparation.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Home", "body": "Initializing desktop overlay and sprite graphics engine. Your pet will spawn shortly!", "show_time_estimate": true}}
7: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout for Adoption Certificate Final Step: Transform the adoption certificate step into a stage layout featuring an official adoption badge stamp component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Verified", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [finish, incentive] First Desktop Treat Reward Prompt: Add a welcome treat reward badge component on the final home_intro screen upon completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Pack Unlocked: +3 Desktop Pet Treats", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop System Tray Ready Ping Toggle: Enable notify_when_ready on the waiting screen so users get a desktop notification when background pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to hop onto your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns choose path layout while retaining both adoption options without violating rules.
Adds a visual progress screen within onboarding while preserving all required onboarding steps.
Modifies home_intro with an interactive control checklist, which is permitted within onboarding.
Reordering sign_in before certificate finalization is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adds an informative sign-in hint without violating any onboarding constraints.
Clarifies copy while continuing to offer both pre-made adoption and custom pet creation.
Updates waiting screen status and time estimate for a real wait time without dark patterns.
Redesigns certificate screen with an official verification badge while keeping its core function intact.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras/rewards ('Starter Pack Unlocked: +3 Desktop Pet Treats'), violating Rule 3.
Adds a desktop notification option on the waiting screen, which is permitted under Rule 4.
